Nora (Mercury Health): Hey Redwood — we're looking to onboard a specialist NER + classification model trained on our claims data. Needs PHI-safe handling, HSM for keys, and low-latency for inline patient triage (p95 < 200ms). Can someone advise next steps?

Jamal (Customer Success): Thanks Nora — welcome! Quick clarifying Qs: do you want Redwood Hosted API, Dedicated, or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Also is the model private (you'll host weights) or do you want us to host a packaged artifact?

Nora (Mercury Health): Prefer Private VPC with customer-managed keys (HSM). We'll bring the model artifact (13B fine-tuned).

Priya (Solutions Eng): @Nora thanks. Two immediate asks from our side: 1) sample volume & average sequence length (tokens) so we can size KV cache and batch config; 2) a redacted sample dataset and eval prompt set for safety/quality checks.

Nora (Mercury Health): We have ~150k labeled examples, avg 120–300 tokens. I'll upload a 500-sample redacted set and the eval prompt spreadsheet by EOD.

Owen (Security): Heads-up on PHI: Private VPC + HSM is the right path. We'll need an E2E dataflow diagram and a short threat model doc. Also confirm whether de-identification is handled upstream or should happen inside the model pipeline.

Nora (Mercury Health): De-id upstream; but we still need audit logs and token-level retention disabled.

Kei (SRE): For latency, p95 < 200ms on a 13B in a private deployment is achievable with GPU+KV caching and small dynamic batch sizes. We need target QPS and allowed burst. Also any DR/HA constraints?

Nora (Mercury Health): Target steady QPS 6 requests/s with bursts to 25 for peak hours. HA: multi-az preferred.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll draft a sizing plan. Also, to help with cost/quantization tradeoffs: are you open to int8 or 4-bit quantized variants? They reduce latency but can affect rare-entity recall.

Nora (Mercury Health): We need recall on PHI entities to be >99% in eval sets. So we prefer no aggressive quantization for first rollout.

Ava (Product): For rollout, recommend Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on false-positive/negative regression thresholds. We'll pair this with our eval harness to watch entity-level regressions.

Jamal (Customer Success): Action items summary: 1) Nora to upload 500-sample redacted eval + eval spreadsheet; 2) Nora to send dataflow diagram + threat model; 3) Priya to produce sizing + recommended infra (GPU type, caching, batch config); 4) Owen to draft compliance checklist for HSM + audit logs; 5) Ava to prepare rollout plan. SLA/renewal note: I'll flag this customer as "high-touch" for the renewal playbook—we should capture time-to-value metrics.

redwood-intake-bot: New intake created: <https://console.redwood.ai/intakes/INT-2026-1147|INT-2026-1147> — assigned to Jamal, Priya.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick eval runner snippet I'll use once we have samples:
```
# quick local eval command (sanitized)
python eval_runner.py --model-path /mnt/model --input samples.json --metrics "entity_recall,entity_precision,latency_p95" --batch-size 1
```

Owen (Security): Also adding: must provide KMS policy snippet for the HSM integration and confirmation that model artifacts won't be exfiltrated from customer VPC.

Nora (Mercury Health): Confirmed — artifacts stay in our VPC, keys in customer HSM. We'll share the KMS policy template.

Kei (SRE): I'll model the autoscaling policy: keep 2 warm workers, scale by cpu/gpu queue length; configure prefix cache for common templates. Priya, can you add expected token distribution?

Priya (Solutions Eng): Will add token distribution to the sizing doc.

Jamal (Customer Success): I'll schedule a 30-min intake call for tomorrow 11am PT to walk through the upload and go/no-go checklist. Nora — does that work?

Nora (Mercury Health): Works for me. Thanks everyone! :handshake:

Ava (Product): Putting a note in the renewal tracker: onboarding complexity + PHI = likely renewal expansion if time-to-value < 60 days. We'll follow eval pass milestones.

redwood-intake-bot: Reminder set: intake follow-up meeting at 2026-06-09T18:00:00Z.
